blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have led to rapid progress in video understanding across a wide range of benchmark tasks. However, existing evaluations largely focus on short-term reasoning, failing to assess a critical capability: maintaining cumulative temporal consistency over extended time horizons. To close this evaluation gap, we introduce HeiCo-FOCUS, a clinically grounded dataset for evaluating long-context video understanding through the task of F oreign O bject C ontextual U nderstanding in S urgery. Built on a dataset of Hei delberg Co lorectal surgeries, this task requires models to continuously track multiple objects as they are inserted, manipulated, occluded, and removed over procedures lasting up to hours.
HeiCo-FOCUS comprises 30,000 visual question answering pairs covering five core capabilities: object recognition, temporal grounding, aggregation, event and procedural understanding, and complex reasoning. The dataset was constructed through a rigorous multi-stage annotation pipeline involving large-scale crowd annotation and 39 surgical domain experts to ensure high quality and clinical relevance. To systematically probe model behavior, we introduce a multi-track evaluation framework that progressively increases temporal and contextual demands from single frames to full procedures.
Experiments with ten frontier Vision-Language Models show that HeiCo-FOCUS tasks are far from solved: only around half of the models clearly outperform a text-only baseline. Across the video tracks, models perform best on event and procedural understanding (mean Accuracy: 56.5% across all models), while temporal grounding remains particularly challenging for all evaluated models (mean Accuracy: 19.7%). We therefore expect HeiCo-FOCUS to serve as a catalyst for the development of models capable of reliable, temporally consistent reasoning over hours-long videos. Code is available at https://github.com/IMSY-DKFZ/orena-focus . The data will be published on Hugging Face soon; until then, please contact the corresponding authors for access.

blocks.en: Recent progress in general-domain Vision-Language Models has enabled temporal reasoning over extended video streams ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Comanici et al., 2025 ) . Emerging long-video benchmarks evaluate these capabilities, showing improvements in tasks such as visual question answering and event understanding over longer temporal contexts ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Chandrasegaran et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2024 ; Zohar et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2023 ) . However, these benchmarks primarily assess local reasoning within extended segments and do not require persistent tracking of entities across long horizons or the aggregation of state over time.
blocks.zh: 近期在通用域景-语言模型方面取得的进展使得时间推理能够超越扩展的视频流(Bai等,2025;Comanici等,2025)。 新兴的长视频基准评价了这些能力,显示在较长时间背景下的视觉问答和事件理解等任务有所改进(吴等,2024;钱德拉塞加兰等,2024;傅等,2025;沈等,2024;赵哈尔等,2025;王等,2025b;刘等,2024;周等,2025;洪等,2023). 然而,这些基准主要评估扩展段内的当地推理,不需要持续跟踪跨长期的实体,也不需要长期汇总状态。

blocks.en:
Surgical videos represent a particularly important and challenging domain: procedures unfold over tens of minutes to hours, involve continuous scene changes, and require precise interpretation of fine-grained visual cues. Despite this, the surgical AI community has so far lacked a dedicated, standardized benchmark to assess whether emerging long-context video capabilities translate to real clinical workflows (see Table 1 in Appendix A ). The HeiCo-FOCUS dataset addresses this unmet need by introducing a structured benchmark centered on a concrete patient safety problem: ensuring the retrieval of foreign objects at the end of surgery (see Figure 1 ). In minimally invasive surgical procedures, surgical sponges, sutures, and other foreign objects are inserted into the abdomen via trocar sites to carry out steps of the procedure. Unintentionally leaving foreign objects in the abdomen is a rare but consequential incident, as they can cause serious complications ( Badiee et al., 2025 ; Weprin et al., 2021 ) . Using foreign objects as the central theme, HeiCo-FOCUS offers comprehensive capability coverage, spanning object recognition, temporal grounding, aggregation, event and procedural understanding, and complex reasoning, enabling fine-grained analysis of model capabilities (Figure 2 ).
From a long video benchmarking perspective, keeping track of foreign objects is a highly attractive application because it inherently requires persistent memory, temporal consistency, and aggregation over extended time horizons.
blocks.zh:
外科视频代表着一个特别重要和具有挑战性的领域:程序在数十分钟至数小时之间展开,涉及持续场景变化,需要精确地解释精细的视觉提示. 尽管如此,迄今为止,外科人工智能社区缺乏一个专门、标准化的基准,以评估新出现的长文本视频能力是否转化为真正的临床工作流程(见附录A中的表1)。 HeiCo-FOCUS数据集针对这一未得到满足的需求,采用了一个以具体病人安全问题为中心的结构化基准:确保在外科手术结束时取回外物(见图一)。 在最小的入侵外科手术中,外科海绵、缝合物和其他外用物品通过特洛伊车站插入腹部,以实施手术步骤。 无意地将外物留在腹部是一种罕见但会引发后果的事件,因为它们可能造成严重的并发症(Badiee等,2025;Weprin等,2021)。 利用外国物体作为中心主题,海合会-FOCUS提供全面的能力覆盖范围,涵盖对象识别、时间定位、汇总、事件和程序理解以及复杂的推理,从而能够对模型能力进行精细分析(图2)。
从长时间的视频基准角度来说,跟踪外国物体是一个非常有吸引力的应用,因为它本质上需要持续的内存、时间一致性和在较长的时间范围内的聚合。

blocks.en: The uniqueness of HeiCo-FOCUS is rooted in three fundamental design decisions: 1. Quality-first approach: While large-scale, large language model (LLM) curated datasets have significantly accelerated progress in AI, they primarily serve the purpose of training models and inevitably contain noise. In contrast, evaluation benchmarks require the highest possible level of reliability, as their credibility directly determines the validity of scientific comparisons. Recent work in medical AI has highlighted how insufficient data provenance can undermine research quality and even contribute to paper retractions ( Gibson et al., 2026 ) . HeiCo-FOCUS directly addresses this critical gap by providing a fully trusted benchmark: (1) building upon a trusted, clinically curated base dataset (HeiCo; Maier-Hein et al., 2021 ), and (2) involving human experts at every stage of the annotation pipeline to ensure high-quality, clinically meaningful annotations and evaluation. Notably, compared to more than 400 analyzed medical imaging AI benchmarks (median: 3 annotators) ( Reinke et al., 2026 ) , HeiCo-FOCUS involved more than an order of magnitude more domain experts, reflecting the substantial annotation effort required to produce a clinically reliable benchmark. 2. Persistent object identities for long-context visual question answering: Existing surgical visual question answering datasets largely generate question-answer pairs by converting existing vision annotations using large language models. This introduces a fundamental limitation: many clinically relevant questions are never covered. For example, questions related to retained foreign objects require persistent object identities over long time horizons. Existing datasets do not provide instance-level annotations, current models cannot reliably generate them automatically, and manual annotation is prohibitively expensive as illustrated by the enormous cost of our dataset. Furthermore, automatically generated questions are inherently limited by the underlying annotations and often fail to capture clinically meaningful long-context reasoning. HeiCo-FOCUS closes this gap through a dedicated, expert-driven annotation pipeline that explicitly annotates object instances (Figure 3 ). Without HeiCo-FOCUS, the community will lack a clinically grounded benchmark for systematically evaluating long-context understanding tasks that require persistent object identities. 3. Clinical relevance: Many surgical AI datasets have been designed around procedures and tasks that are easiest to acquire and annotate, rather than those with the greatest clinical need. This is nicely illustrated by a recent scoping review ( Carstens et al., 2025 ) that showed that laparoscopic cholecystectomy accounts for more than 50% of surgical AI studies and has therefore largely driven progress in the field. This is interesting because cholecystectomies are technically straightforward procedures with low complication rates ( ∼ \sim 2–3%; Duca et al., 2003 ), suggesting that their predominance is driven by available landmark datasets. As datasets shape research priorities, benchmarks should steer research toward clinically important problems. Uniquely, HeiCo-FOCUS addresses both: a huge technical challenge (long-context video understanding) and an actual globally important clinical problem. Instead of further expanding cholecystectomy datasets, we deliberately chose colorectal procedures (complications in up to one third of patients; Tevis & Kennedy, 2016 ), which present an up to 15 times higher complication rate, 5-fold longer procedures, and on average three times more foreign object instances per video.
blocks.zh: HeiCo-FOCUS的独特性植根于三个基本设计决定: 1. 质量第一办法: 虽然大型,大型语言模型(LLM)所编译的数据集大大地加快了AI的进步,但它们主要服务于培训模型的目的,并不可避免地会包含噪声. 相比之下,评价基准需要尽可能高的可靠性,因为其可信度直接决定了科学比较的有效性. 最近关于医疗AI的工作突出表明,数据来源不足会如何损害研究质量,甚至会助长论文的撤回(Gibson等人,2026年)。 HeiCo-FOCUS通过提供完全可信赖的基准,直接解决了这一关键差距:(1)基于一个可信赖的,临床整理的基础数据集(HeiCo;Maier-Hein等,2021年),和(2)让人类专家参加注释管道的每个阶段,以确保高质量的,临床有意义的说明和评价. 值得注意的是,与400多份经过分析的医学成像AI基准(中间体:3个注释员)(Reinke等人,2026年)相比,HeiCo-FOCUS吸收了超过一个数量级的更多领域专家,这反映了编制临床上可靠的基准所需的大量注释努力。 2. 用于长文本可视化问题的持久对象身份回答: 现有的外科视觉问题回答数据集大多通过使用大型语言模型来转换现有的视觉说明来生成出问答对. 这带来了一个根本的局限性:许多临床相关问题从未涉及. 例如,与保留外国物体有关的问题需要长期持续的物体身份。 现有数据集不提供实例级说明,当前模型无法可靠地自动生成这些说明,手动注释费用昂贵,这从我们数据集的巨大成本中可以看出。 此外,自动产生的问题本身受到基本说明的限制,往往无法掌握临床上有意义的长文推理。 HeiCo-FOCUS通过一个专门、由专家推动的注解管道来填补这一空白,该管道明确对物体实例进行注解(图3)。 如果没有HeiCo-FOCUS,社区将缺乏基于临床的基准,无法系统地评价需要持续识别对象的长文本理解任务. 3. 临床相关性: 许多外科人工智能数据集的设计都围绕着最容易获取和注释的程序和任务,而不是临床需求最大的程序和任务. 最近的一项范围审查(Carstens等人,2025年)很好地说明了这一点,该审查表明,膝盖切除术占外科人工智能研究的50%以上,因此在很大程度上推动了该领域的进展。 这很有趣,因为胆囊切除术在技术上是简单的程序,其复杂率很低(\\ sim 2-3%;Duca等人,2003年),这表明其主导地位是由现有的里程碑数据集所驱动的。 随着数据集决定研究的优先次序,基准应引导研究转向临床上重要的问题。 独具特色的是,"海会-FOCUS"既涉及:一个巨大的技术挑战(长篇视频理解),又涉及一个实际的全球重要临床问题. 我们没有进一步扩大胆囊切除数据集,而是刻意选择了分泌分泌程序(患者最多可达三分之一;Tevis & Kennedy,2016年),这些分泌分泌分泌的复杂率高达15倍,程序长了5倍,每部视频平均比外物事件多出3倍.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Long video benchmarks, such as ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Chandrasegaran et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2024 ; Zohar et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2023 ; Mangalam et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2019 ) have been instrumental in advancing video understanding beyond short clips by introducing tasks that require reasoning over extended temporal contexts. However, they still typically rely on relatively short temporal windows—often limited to a few minutes.
blocks.zh: 长视频基准,如(吴等,2024;钱德拉塞加兰等,2024;傅等,2025;沈等,2024;赵哈尔等,2025;王等,2025b;刘等. ; 2024; 周克等, 2025; 洪克等, 2023; 曼加拉姆等, 2023; 吴克等, 2025; 于克等, 2019)通过引入需要推理的任务来推进视频理解超越短片. 然而,它们通常仍然依赖相对较短的时间窗口——往往限于几分钟。

blocks.en: Several groups have pioneered the development of surgical visual question answering datasets, with existing resources summarized in Table 1 (Appendix A ). These datasets have significantly advanced the field by providing large-scale question–answer pairs and enabling the training of multimodal models in surgical domains. In particular, recent datasets have reached substantial scale in terms of both video volume and number of visual question answering pairs. However, despite these advances, several important limitations remain. First, existing datasets are restricted to frame-level or short video clips, with little to no support for long-context reasoning beyond a few minutes. As a result, they do not capture the temporal dependencies and cumulative reasoning required in real surgical workflows. Second, questions are often limited to perception and event understanding. We are not aware of a single surgical AI dataset that addresses temporal grounding and long-context reasoning. Third, many datasets rely either on rule-based categorical question generation ( Seenivasan et al., 2022 ) or on AI-generated visual question answering pairs sourced from public platforms like YouTube, utilizing automated audio transcription and rephrasing ( Li et al., 2026 ; Perez et al., 2026 ) . Fourth, expert verification is largely absent, with only a small fraction of datasets reporting systematic review by medical professionals.

blocks.en: 3 HeiCo-FOCUS
blocks.zh: 3 海同财团

blocks.en: HeiCo-FOCUS is a clinically grounded benchmark for evaluating long-context video understanding. Based on all 30 Hei delberg C olorectal Surgeries of the HeiCo dataset ( Maier-Hein et al., 2021 ) , it contributes 30,000 visual question answering pairs addressing F oreign O bject C ontextual U nderstanding in S urgery.
blocks.zh: HeiCo-FOCUS是评价长文本视频理解的临床基准. 基于"海可"数据集的所有30个"海克"(Hei delberg C olorectal Surgeies)(Maier-Hein等,2021年),它贡献了30,000个视觉问题解答对,针对S expressry的F orign O 弹出克上文本Understanding.

blocks.en: The original HeiCo dataset comprises a total of 30 colorectal surgical procedures, including 10 sigmoid resections, 10 rectal resections, and 10 proctocolectomies, annotated with surgical phases and instruments. We deliberately build upon this trusted resource to (1) leverage an established, ethically governed clinical dataset with transparent provenance, (2) focus on complex procedures with substantial complication rates and a broad diversity of foreign objects, and (3) enable researchers to combine HeiCo-FOCUS with the rich existing HeiCo annotations, facilitating complementary analyses of surgical phases, instruments, and long-context object dynamics on the same procedures. For each procedure, we generated 1,000 visual question answering pairs, comprising 400 questions for the FRAME track, 400 for the SEGMENT track, and 200 for the PROCEDURE track. The visual question answering generation pipeline (see Section 4 ) was designed to achieve approximately balanced coverage across all capability categories and temporal contexts. To support fine-grained evaluation and stratified analysis, each visual question answering pair is associated with structured metadata including the expected answer format (e.g., open ended, an integer number, a time estimate, etc.) and associated capabilities (see Section 4.1 ). Following the original HeiCo dataset split ( Maier-Hein et al., 2021 ) , we recommend using the sigmoid resection procedures as the held-out test set (4,000 FRAME, 4,000 SEGMENT, and 2,000 PROCEDURE questions). To comply with the original HeiCo license, HeiCo-FOCUS is released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Usage and access details are presented in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 最初的"海克"数据集由总共30个有外科外科手术程序组成,包括10个西格莫德分科,10个直肠分科和10个有外科阶段和仪器注释的蛋白管分科. 我们刻意利用这一可信赖的资源,(1) 利用一个具有透明出处的、符合道德规范的临床数据集,(2) 侧重于具有大量复杂率和广泛多样性的复杂程序,(3) 使研究人员能够将海合会-FOCUS与现有的丰富的海合会说明结合起来,便利对外科阶段、仪器和长写对象动态进行互补分析。 对于每个程序,我们产生了1 000个视觉问题回答对,包括FRAME轨道400个问题、SEGMENT轨道400个问题、程序轨道200个问题。 视觉问题解答生成管道(见第4节)旨在实现所有能力类别和时间背景的大致均衡覆盖。 为了支持精细的评价和分层分析,每个可视问题回答对都与结构化的元数据有关,包括预期的答案格式(如:开端,整数,时间估计等)和相关能力(见第4.1节. 在最初的"HeiCo"数据集分拆(Maier-Hein等,2021年)后,我们建议使用 sigmoid再分解程序作为被搁置的测试集(4,000 FRAME,4,000 SEGMENT,和2,000个程序问题). 为了遵守"黑Co"的原始许可证,"黑Co-FOCUS"根据CC BY-NC-SA 4.0发布. 使用和访问详情见附录B。

blocks.en: The design of HeiCo-FOCUS was guided by the following principles:
blocks.zh: 海合会-FOCUS的设计遵循了以下原则:

blocks.en: A central design objective was to ensure that the benchmark is both clinically meaningful and technically rigorous. To achieve this, surgical experts were closely involved throughout all stages of the benchmark development.
blocks.zh: 一项中心设计目标是确保基准既具有临床意义,又在技术上严格。 为此,外科专家密切参与了基准制定的所有阶段。

blocks.en: To enable a detailed analysis of model behavior, we developed a comprehensive capability taxonomy (see Figure 2 ) that spans multiple dimensions of visual and temporal understanding. Secondly, to allow for controlled analysis of how model performance evolves from instantaneous perception to long-horizon reasoning, the benchmark was structured into three complementary tracks: a FRAME Track to assess single-image understanding, focusing on perception and aggregation tasks, a SEGMENT Track to assess short-term video understanding (all capabilities) within video segments of up to 5 min and a PROCEDURE Track to assess long-context capabilities over extended video durations from the beginning up to a time point t (5–296 min).
blocks.zh: 为了能够对模型行为进行详细分析,我们开发出一种涵盖视觉和时间理解的多维的全面能力分类学(见图2). 第二,为了对模型性能如何从即时感知演变为长视距推理进行有控制的分析,该基准被分为三个互补轨道:一个FRAME Track来评估单象理解,侧重于感知和聚合任务;一个SEUMENT Track来评估视频段内最长达5分钟的短期视频理解(所有能力),以及一个程序跟踪来评估从开始到时间t(5–296分)的长时间视频期间的长视距能力.

blocks.en: To ensure high annotation quality, we implemented a multi-stage annotation pipeline (see Figure 3 , Section 4.2 , and Table 2 in Appendix D ) combining automated methods, large-scale crowd annotation, and expert annotation and verification. Overall, 39 domain experts (clinical and technical) were involved in the data annotation (7 expert surgeons, 18 medical students, 14 surgical AI researchers).
blocks.zh: 为确保高注释质量,我们实施了多阶段注释管道(见图3,第4.2节,附录D表2),结合了自动化方法、大规模人群注释以及专家注释和核实。 总体而言,39名领域专家(临床和技术专家)参与了数据注释(7名外科专家、18名医学生、14名外科人工智能研究人员)。

blocks.en: To prevent questions from being answered based solely on prior knowledge or textual plausibility ( Mayer et al., 2025 ; Asadi et al., 2026 ) , all questions were filtered with a panel of text-only models ( blind filter ), as detailed below. Furthermore, the capability taxonomy enables stratified analyses across different capabilities, preventing overrepresentation of simpler tasks (e.g., object identification) from dominating performance estimates. Finally, the hierarchical structure of the data - where multiple questions are associated with the same video or segment - is explicitly accounted for in the statistical analysis, for example through hierarchical aggregation and bootstrapping.
blocks.zh: 为了防止仅仅根据先前的知识或文字可信度来回答问题(Mayer等人,2025年;Asadi等人,2026年),所有问题都用一组只用文字的模型(盲过滤器)过滤,详情如下: 此外,能力分类可以进行不同能力的分层分析,防止较简单的任务(例如物的识别)的过多比例占据业绩估计。 最后,在统计分析中明确阐述了数据的分级结构----即多个问题与同一视频或段相关联----例如,通过分级汇总和拖曳。

blocks.en: 4 visual question answering Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4 个视觉问题回答生成管道

blocks.en: The HeiCo-FOCUS dataset was constructed through a multi-stage annotation pipeline designed to balance scalability with high clinical and technical quality.
blocks.zh: 海同-FOCUS数据集是通过多相注释管来构建的,旨在平衡可扩展性与高临床和技术质量.

blocks.en: 4.1 Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 4.1 分类学

blocks.en: Our taxonomy for surgical visual question answering is depicted in Figure 2 . For question categorization, each question is assigned to one primary capability category and may optionally be tagged with additional secondary sub-categories to reflect its multi-faceted nature. The primary category is determined by the dominant reasoning requirement of the question. For example, “Where” questions are assigned to object recognition and identity matching → \rightarrow spatial localization , “How many” questions to aggregation , and “When” questions to temporal grounding → \rightarrow temporal localization . This primary assignment enables the balancing of visual question answering pairs across capabilities while secondary labels allow fine-grained stratified evaluation. The complete taxonomy is provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们的外科视觉问题解答分类在图2中描述。 就问题分类而言,每个问题被划入一个主要能力类别,并且可以选择附加二级分类别,以反映其多面性。 主要类别由问题的主要推理要求决定。 例如,“在哪里”问题被分配到对象识别和身份匹配 ——\平准空间定位 ,“多少”问题归并,“何时”问题到时间定位 ——\平准时间定位 。 这一主要任务能够平衡各种能力的视觉问题回答对,而次要标签则允许分层评估。 完整的分类法见附录C。

blocks.zh: 图2:海合会-FOCUS分类学,抽样问题;附录C中的定义。

blocks.en: 4.2 Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.2 说明管道

blocks.en: Our annotation pipeline combines large-scale crowd annotation, automated processing, and expert-driven refinement to progressively enrich the data from raw video to clinically meaningful and verified visual question answering pairs, as illustrated in Figure 3 and detailed in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们的注解管道结合了大规模人群注解,自动化处理,以及专家驱动的完善,以逐步丰富数据,从原始视频到临床上有意义的,经过核实的视觉问题答对,如图3所说明,附录D所详述.

blocks.en: The process began with Stage 1 , in which short video clips were screened to identify the presence of foreign objects. In Stage 2 , frames sampled at 1 frame per second from relevant segments were annotated with bounding boxes and class labels. These initial annotations were subsequently refined in Stage 3 with automated methods that correct and complete bounding box predictions.
blocks.zh: 这一过程始于第一阶段,其中放映了短视频片段,以识别是否存在外国物体。 在第二阶段中,从相关部分中以每秒1帧的方式抽取的帧被附加了边框和分级标签。 这些最初的说明后来在第三阶段得到完善,采用自动方法,纠正并完成相框预测。

blocks.en: Stage 4 was by far the most resource-intensive one. Here, 18 medical students assigned consistent instance identities to individual objects across time, yielding a structured representation of foreign object trajectories. This required the generation of bounding boxes around foreign objects at 1 frame per second and for more than 300 k frames in total. Appendix I illustrates annotation challenges.
blocks.zh: 第四阶段是迄今为止资源最密集的阶段。 这里,18名医学院学生将一致的实例身份分配给单个物体,从而产生了外国物体轨迹的结构化表述. 这就需要以每秒1个帧和总共300多克帧的速度,在外星物体周围产生捆绑箱。 附录一说明了说明方面的挑战。

blocks.en: Building on the fine-grained instance-level annotations, Stage 5 derived anchor moments, such as insertion and retrieval events, long absences, and cluttered scenes, which served as key reference points for visual question answering generation. visual question answering pairs were then created through a combination of automated template-based methods filtered by medical students for validity, and surgical expert-designed questions, ensuring coverage across capability categories and complexity levels. Finally, in Stage 6 , the whole visual question answering generation pipeline was verified by the analysis of about 500 diverse sample questions, covering all capabilities and foreign objects.
blocks.zh: 以精细的例级说明为基础,第5阶段衍生出主播时刻,如插入和取回事件,长时间的缺席,和杂乱无章的场景,为视觉问答生成提供了关键的参考点. 然后,通过医科学生过滤的基于模板的自动方法的有效性和外科专家设计的问题相结合,创建了视觉问题答对,确保涵盖能力类别和复杂程度。 最后,在"第六阶段"中,整个视觉问题解答生成管道通过对大约500个不同样本问题的分析得到验证,涵盖所有能力和外物体.

blocks.en: Once the complete annotation pipeline had been validated, it was applied to generate a total of 30,000 visual question answering pairs for the HeiCo-FOCUS benchmark, as detailed in the following section. To further promote transparency, quality control, and continuous improvement, we additionally provide a community feedback mechanism that enables users to report potentially ambiguous or erroneous cases during a restricted post-release review period.
blocks.zh: 完整的注解管道被验证后,应用于为海同-FOCUS基准生成总共30,000个可视答题对,详见下节. 为了进一步促进透明度、质量控制和不断改进,我们还提供了社区反馈机制,使用户能够在有限的释放后审查期内报告可能含糊不清或错误的案件。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Multi-stage annotation pipeline of HeiCo-FOCUS. Raw surgical videos are progressively transformed into high-quality, clinically grounded visual question answering (VQA) pairs. Stages 1-3 perform foreign object detection, followed by Stage 4, where instances are linked across time. In Stage 5, visual question answering pairs are generated using a combination of expert-designed questions and instance-informed automatic templates. Stage 6 conducts end-to-end expert verification.
blocks.zh: 图3:海同-FOCUS多相注释管. 原始外科视频被逐渐转化成高质量的,临床上基于视觉问题的回答对等. 第1-3阶段进行外星物体探测,然后是第4阶段,在第四阶段,各种实例是相互连接的。 在第五阶段,可视问题回答对是使用专家设计的问题和实例信息自动模板组合生成的。 第6阶段进行端到端专家核查。

blocks.en: 4.3 visual question answering Design
blocks.zh: 4.3 视觉问答

blocks.en: The visual question answering generation process builds upon Stage 4 of the annotation pipeline (see Figure 3 ), which resulted in 324,273 manually curated frames containing 79,682 verified foreign-object bounding boxes. Every class except clips carries instance identities across time (55,629 boxes); as it turned out to be infeasible to do instance linking for clips (even for expert surgeons), they were annotated for visibility only and excluded from questions that require following an individual object over time. These high-quality instance-level annotations provide a structured representation of object trajectories over time and enable automatic generation of questions for a large subset of capabilities, including temporal grounding, aggregation, and multi-step compositional reasoning. However, several sub-capabilities-particularly functional reasoning, causal reasoning, and anatomically grounded localization-required additional clinical expertise beyond what can be derived from instance annotations alone. To ensure both high clinical validity and broad capability coverage, the question generation therefore followed a multi-stage, expert-guided pipeline combining manual annotation, expert validation, and automated augmentation.
blocks.zh: 视觉问题回答生成过程以注解管道第4阶段(见图3)为基础,该阶段产生了324 273个手动装订框架,其中装有79 682个经核实的外物体捆绑箱。 除了剪辑以外,每一门课都带有各种实例身份(55 629个盒);事实证明,将剪辑连接起来(即使是专家外科医生)是不可行的,因此,它们只被注解为能见度,并被排除在需要随个别物体随时间而变化的问题之外。 这些高质量的实例级说明为随着时间的推移的物体轨迹提供了结构化的表述,并使得能够自动生成大量子集能力的问题,包括时间搁浅,集合,多步构成推理. 然而,若干次能力 -- -- 特别是功能推理、因果推理和解剖本地化 -- -- 所需要的额外临床专门知识,超出了仅从实例说明中即可得出的结果。 为了确保高临床有效性和广泛的能力覆盖面,问题组采用多阶段、由专家指导的管道,结合人工说明、专家鉴定和自动增强。

blocks.en: We first defined a catalog of candidate question templates covering all benchmark tracks and capability categories (e.g., “How many <foreign object>s were inserted during this video segment”). Each template was associated with metadata specifying its applicable track, primary and secondary capability labels, relevant foreign object classes, required visual evidence, and answer format. In parallel, we derived informative anchor moments from the instance-level annotations, including potential insertion and retrieval events, long absence intervals, and visually cluttered frames or segments. These anchors served as high-value time points for clinically meaningful, technically challenging questions.
blocks.zh: 我们首先界定了涵盖所有基准轨迹和能力类别的候选问题模板目录(例如,“在这一视频段期间插入了多少个<外国对象>”)。 每个模板都与元数据相关,具体说明其适用的轨道、初级和二级能力标签、相关的外国对象类别、所需的视觉证据和答案格式。 同时,我们从实例层面的说明中得出了信息化主播瞬间,包括潜在的插入和检索事件、长时间的缺勤间隔以及视觉杂乱的帧或片段。 这些锚点是临床上有意义的、技术上具有挑战性的问题的高值时间点。

blocks.en: Based on question and anchor moment candidates, medical students validated automatically generated anchor moments, confirming insertion and retrieval events and pre-filtered generated questions. These questions were either answered when confidence was high, discarded if ill-posed, or flagged for expert review when uncertainty remained. Next, expert surgeons reviewed these flagged cases, validated anchor moments, and provided authoritative answers. In addition, they enriched the dataset by contributing new questions that could be asked at any time during the procedures. In this step, experts were asked to target underrepresented capabilities such as reasoning, functional understanding, and anatomically grounded localization, for which questions cannot be automatically answered based on instance annotations.
blocks.zh: 根据提问和锁定瞬间候选人,医学院学生验证自动生成锚瞬间,确认插入和取回事件,并预过滤生成了问题. 这些问题要么在信任度高时得到回答,要么在没有把握的情况下被抛弃,要么在不确定性依然存在时被标出供专家审查。 接下来,专家外科医生审查了这些标有标记的病例,验证了锚点,并提供了权威的答案. 此外,他们还提出了可在程序期间随时提出的新问题,从而丰富了数据集。 在这一步骤中,请专家针对代表性不足的能力,如推理、功能理解和解剖本地化,这些问题不能根据实例说明自动回答。

blocks.en: To achieve a balanced benchmark, clinician-written questions were complemented with question templates systematically instantiated both at clinically informative anchor moments and at other eligible time points to ensure broad coverage across capabilities, foreign-object classes, answer values, and temporal contexts. For sampling, the taxonomy was represented as a tree whose leaves contained 85 question templates, and questions were iteratively drawn from the least represented capability, sub-capability, template, and template instance. Within templates, sampling was additionally balanced across answer values and distributed over time.
blocks.zh: 为了实现均衡的基准,临床医生撰写的问题得到在临床信息主播时刻和其他合格时间点系统地即时处理的问题模板的补充,以确保涵盖各种能力、外国对象类别、答案值和时间背景。 就取样而言,分类法作为一棵树,树的叶子有85个问题模板,从代表最少的能力、子能力、模板和模板实例中反复抽取问题。 在模板中,抽样在答复值之间得到了进一步的平衡并随时间而分布。

blocks.en: After end-to-end verification of the complete annotation process, we followed the described steps to generate 1,000 visual question answering pairs per video. To remove questions answerable from text alone, three models (Mistral Small 2603, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, and DeepSeek V4 Flash) answered every candidate question without the image or video, with the option to answer “unsure”; a question was discarded if all three answered correctly.
blocks.zh: 在对完整的注释过程进行端到端的验证后,我们遵循所描述的步骤,每个视频生成1000个可视问题回答对. 为了单独从文本中删除回答的问题,三个模型(Mistral Small 2603,双子座2.5 Flash Lite,和DeepSeek V4 Flash)在没有图像或视频的情况下回答了每一个候选问题,选择回答"不确定";如果三个答案都正确,一个问题就被放弃了.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: Figure 4: Overall performance for all models and tracks. Accuracy is the mean of per-video Accuracy. Uncertainty is depicted using bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 图4:所有模型和轨道的总体性能。 准确性是"per-video 准确"的平均值. 不确定性的描绘是使用有95%的自信间隔。

blocks.en: We evaluated model performance primarily using accuracy. Answers were parsed according to their expected format (Table 3 ). Open-ended, multiple-choice, and matching answers were graded for semantic equivalence by a Large Language Model (LLM) judge (gpt-oss-120b, validated against two human raters in Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 我们主要利用准确性评价模型性能。 答复按预期格式进行解析(表3)。 一个大语言模型(LLM)法官(gpt-oss-120b,在附录F中针对两个人评分进行验证)对语义等同的无限制、多选择和匹配答案进行了分级。

blocks.en: All evaluations were conducted via cloud-based Application Programming Interfaces to ensure a standardized and reproducible evaluation environment. The benchmark includes a representative selection of current frontier Vision-Language Models, namely GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, Meta Muse Spark 1.3, xAI Grok-4.3, DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision, Amazon Nova 2 Lite, and Xiaomi MiMo-V 2.5. Details on the prompts provided to the Vision-Language Models can be found in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 所有评价都通过基于云的应用程序编程接口进行,以确保标准化和可再生的评价环境。 基准包括当前前沿视野-语言模型的代表性选择,即GPT-5.6 Sol、克洛德·索内特5、双子座3.8 Flash、双子座3 Flash、双子座3.5 Flash Lite、Meta Muse Spark 1.3、xAI Grok-4.3、DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision、Amazon Nova 2 Lite和Xiaomi MiMo-V 2.5 (英语). 附录E详细介绍了向Vision-Language Models提供的提示。

blocks.en: The input pipeline was adapted to the native capabilities of each model. Depending on model support, inputs were provided either as native video or as chronologically ordered frame sequences. To ensure consistency across tracks while balancing temporal granularity and computational efficiency, SEGMENT windows were sampled at 1 frame per second, and PROCEDURE windows were represented by 300 uniformly spaced frames. Visual inputs were standardized to a spatial resolution of 210 × \times 360 pixels.
blocks.zh: 投入管道根据每个模型的本地能力进行调整。 根据模型支持情况,投入要么作为原生视频提供,要么作为按时间顺序排列的帧序列提供。 为确保各轨道的一致性,同时平衡时间颗粒性和计算效率,对SEGMENT窗口进行抽样,每秒1个帧,程序窗口采用300个统一间隔的帧。 视素输入被标准化为空间分辨率为210×正时360像素.

blocks.en: As baseline, we used a no-image setting in which GPT-5.6 Sol received only the textual prompt and question, but no visual input. This baseline assessed the extent to which questions can be answered from textual priors, dataset biases, or linguistic plausibility alone, without visual or temporal grounding.
blocks.zh: 作为基线,我们使用一个无图像设置,其中GPT-5.6 Sol只收到文字提示和质询,但没有视觉输入. 这一基线评估了在不出现视觉或时间因素的情况下,在多大程度上仅从文字前科、数据集偏差或语言上的合理性来回答问题。

blocks.en: In the human baseline, three raters (two surgical residents and one medical student) answered 300 questions on the test videos, drawn from an earlier version of the question pool. They reached 62.0%, 69.8%, and 57.4% Accuracy on the FRAME, SEGMENT, and PROCEDURE track, respectively (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 在人类基线中,3名检测员(2名外科居民和1名医科学生)在测试视频上回答300个问题,这些问题取自早先版本的问题池. 它们分别达到了62.0%、69.8%和57.4%在FRAME、SEMENT和程序轨道上的准确性(附录G)。

blocks.en: The performance of the evaluated Vision-Language Models on the test data is summarized in Figure 4 . On the FRAME track, the highest overall Accuracy was obtained by Gemini 3.8 Flash (44.8% [39.1, 50.1] 95% confidence interval), followed by Gemini 3 Flash (43.2% [39.0, 48.0]) and GPT-5.6 Sol (38.9% [34.3, 44.0]), improving on the text-only baseline (20.7%) by 24.1, 22.5, and 18.2 percentage points, respectively. Only half of the models clearly outperformed the baseline: Muse Spark 1.3 and Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite followed with gains of 15.0 and 14.3 percentage points, whereas the other five models (Claude Sonnet 5, Grok-4.3, MiMo-V 2.5, DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision, and Nova 2 Lite) stayed within 6 percentage points of it. Object recognition and identity matching proved more challenging than aggregation (see Figure 7 in Appendix H ), with object attributes yielding the lowest scores (22.7% averaged over all models; see Figure 8 in Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 图4汇总了经评价的Vision-Langage Models在测试数据上的性能。 在FRAME赛道上,双子座3.8 Flash(44.8% [39.1, 50.1] 95%的置信间隔)获得总的准确度最高,其次是双子座3 Flash(43.2% [39.0, 48.0])和GPT-5.6 Sol(38.9% [34.3%, 44.0]),单文本基线(20.7%)分别提高了24.1%,22.5%和18.2%. 只有一半的模型明显超过了基线: Muse Spark 1.3和双子座 3.5 Flash Lite的成绩相继得到15.0分和14.3分,而其他5个型号(Claude Sonnet 5, Grok-4.3, MiMo-V 2.5, DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision,和Nova 2 Lite)则保持了6分以内. 事实证明,对象识别和身份匹配比汇总更具挑战性(见附录H中的图7),对象属性得分最低(在所有模型中平均为22.7%;见附录H中的图8)。

blocks.en: Across the video tracks, event and procedural understanding obtained the highest scores (average 56.5% across all models), while none of the models achieved satisfactory performance on temporal grounding tasks. With an average Accuracy of 41.7% over all ten models, performance on the SEGMENT track exceeded the text-only baseline (30.4%) by 11.3 percentage points on average. The highest overall Accuracy was obtained by Gemini 3.8 Flash (59.4% [53.9, 64.9]), followed by GPT-5.6 Sol (58.3% [53.2, 63.1]) and Gemini 3 Flash (49.1% [45.3, 52.5]), improving on the baseline by 29.0, 27.9, and 18.7 percentage points, respectively. Temporal grounding was the most difficult capability (see Figure 7 in Appendix H ), with a mean performance of 26.9% averaged over all models.
blocks.zh: 在整个视频轨道上,事件和程序理解获得了最高的分数(在所有模型中平均为56.5%),而没有一个模型在时间定位任务上取得了令人满意的业绩。 在所有10个模型中,平均准确度为41.7%,SEGMENT轨道上的表现平均超过了仅文本基线(30.4%)11.3%。 双子座3.8 Flash(59.4% [53.9,64.9])获得的总精度最高,其次是GPT-5.6 Sol(58.3% [53.2,63.1])和双子座3 Flash(49.1% [45.3,52.5]),比基线分别提高了29.0,27.9%和18.7%. 临时搁浅是最困难的能力(见附录H图7),在所有模型中平均表现为26.9%。

blocks.en: On the PROCEDURE track, Accuracy averaged 37.9% over the ten models (text-only baseline: 27.8%). The highest overall Accuracy was obtained by Gemini 3.8 Flash (56.7% [52.4, 62.0]), followed by GPT-5.6 Sol (51.0% [46.7, 55.1]) and Muse Spark 1.3 (43.8% [38.0, 49.3]). These three models improved on the baseline by 28.9, 23.2, and 16.0 percentage points, respectively, whereas DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision, MiMo-V 2.5, and Nova 2 Lite scored below it. Temporal grounding dropped to 12.6% averaged over all models, less than half of its SEGMENT value.
blocks.zh: 在程序轨道上,精确度平均在10个模型中为37.9%(仅文本基线:27.8%)。 总体准确度最高的是双子座3.8 Flash(56.7% [52.4,62.0]),其次是GPT-5.6 Sol(51.0% [46.7, 55.1])和Muse Spark 1.3(43.8% [38.0, 49.3]). 这三种模型在基线上分别改进了28.9分,23.2分和16.0分,而DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision,MiMo-V 2.5和Nova 2 Lite则得分低于它. 在所有模型中,平均降为12.6%,不到其组分价值的一半。

blocks.en: On the same 300 questions as the human raters, the best model on each track scored 12.0, 12.1, and 6.9 percentage points lower on the FRAME, SEGMENT, and PROCEDURE track, respectively (Table 4 in Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 在与人类评分率相同的300个问题上,每道赛事的最好成绩分别是12.0分,12.1分,而FRAME,SEUMENT,和程序赛道则分别低了6.9个百分点(附录G表4)。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: HeiCo-FOCUS uniquely evaluates long-context video understanding in a real-world, safety-critical setting. Unlike existing datasets that focus on short clips or isolated perception tasks, it requires models to maintain consistent representations of multiple objects over procedures lasting up to hours, where errors accumulate and cannot be corrected from local context. By anchoring evaluation in the concrete task of foreign object tracking and retrieval - an objective, verifiable, and clinically critical problem - the benchmark directly links technical performance to real-world utility.
blocks.zh: HeiCo-FOCUS独家评价了在现实世界,安全关键环境下的长文本视频理解. 与以短片片段或孤立的感知任务为重点的现有数据集不同,它需要模型在长达数小时的程序上保持多个对象的一致表达,其中错误会累积而无法从局部上下文得到纠正. 通过将评价定位在外国物体跟踪和检索这一客观、可核查和临床关键问题的具体任务上,基准将技术绩效与现实世界的效用直接联系起来。

blocks.en: Importantly, our human baseline highlighted the difficulty of the long-context reasoning targeted by HeiCo-FOCUS. Even the human raters reached only 35% on event aggregation and 40% on duration estimation (20 questions each), both of which require following foreign objects over long time spans. This observation retrospectively supports our decision to establish persistent object identities through a dedicated, quality-controlled annotation process rather than asking clinicians to formulate and answer long-context questions directly from the videos. By grounding question generation in these curated instance trajectories, we reduce errors arising from ad-hoc manual reconstruction of object histories while retaining clinical expertise for question types that require higher-level medical reasoning.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,我们的人类基线突出了海合会-FOCUS所瞄准的长文推理的困难。 即使是人类的评分率,在事件汇总上也只有35%,在估计持续时间上只有40%(每个问题20个),两者都需要在较长的时间内跟踪外国物体。 这一观察追溯性地支持了我们的决定,即通过一个专注的、质量控制的注释过程,而不是要求临床医生直接从录像中提出和回答长篇的文字问题,来建立持久的物体身份。 通过将问题生成定位在这些被解析的实例轨迹中,我们减少因专门手工重建物体历史而出错,同时保留需要更高层次医学推理的问题类型的临床专业知识.

blocks.en: To our knowledge, HeiCo-FOCUS is the first surgical visual question answering benchmark to include questions spanning full procedures exceeding 20 minutes while explicitly evaluating persistent object tracking, temporal consistency, and long-horizon aggregation in surgery. However, constructing such a benchmark posed several challenges. First, defining consistent annotation rules for different foreign objects required careful clinical and technical consideration. For example, certain object types, such as surgical staples, can be too small and numerous to be reliably annotated individually by human annotators. Similarly, object-specific decisions, such as how to handle suture threads attached to needles, required detailed annotation guidelines, as documented in the appendix. Second, video artifacts, as well as limited temporal and spatial resolution, posed challenges even for expert annotators (see Appendix I ). Third, designing a capability taxonomy that was simultaneously clinically meaningful, technically informative, and sufficiently disentangled for systematic evaluation required extensive iterative refinement between clinical and technical experts. We addressed many of these challenges through a rigorous transdisciplinary and quality-controlled annotation process involving crowd workers, medical students, surgeons, and surgical AI researchers. Nevertheless, we acknowledge that some annotation and taxonomy decisions may remain debatable. To promote transparency and continuous improvement, we therefore include a community feedback process that allows users to report potentially problematic or ambiguous cases.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,HeiCo-FOCUS是第一个外科视觉问题回答基准,包括涵盖20分钟以上全部程序的问题,同时明确评价持续物体跟踪、时间一致性以及手术中的长视距聚合。 然而,构建这样一个基准提出了若干挑战。 首先,为不同的外国物体确定一致的说明规则需要经过认真的临床和技术考虑。 例如,某些对象类型,如外科主食,可能太小,数量也太多,无法由人类注释者单独可靠地说明. 同样地,特定对象的决定,如如何处理接入针头的缝线,需要详细的说明准则,如附录所记载. 第二,视频文物以及有限的时间和空间分辨率,甚至对专家注释员也构成挑战(见附录一)。 第三,设计一个同时具有临床意义、技术信息丰富、足以进行系统评价的能力分类,需要在临床专家和技术专家之间进行广泛的迭接改进。 我们通过由群众工作者、医科学生、外科医生和外科人工智能研究人员参与的严格的跨学科和质量控制的注释过程,解决了其中许多挑战。 然而,我们承认,某些注释和分类决定可能仍然值得商榷。 因此,为了提高透明度和不断改进,我们包括一个社区反馈程序,使用户能够报告可能存在问题或模棱两可的案件。

blocks.en: Several results deserve further discussion. Accuracy did not follow price: the most accurate model, Gemini 3.8 Flash, cost about a fifth of GPT-5.6 Sol per question on the video tracks (Figure 9 ). While we captured statistical uncertainty via bootstrapping, we did not systematically investigate prompt sensitivity or variability across repeated model runs. Note that, in this context, evaluating long-context VLMs on extended surgical videos incurs substantial monetary and environmental costs (see Figure 9 ), highlighting the need to prioritize efficient evaluation protocols. Finally, the dataset was derived from a limited number of colorectal procedures, which may introduce biases related to surgical style, instrumentation, patient population, or recording conditions. Consequently, benchmark performance should not be interpreted as evidence of safe generalization across procedures, institutions, or clinical settings. Future work should expand the diversity of procedures, institutions, and surgical settings represented in the benchmark, while placing particular emphasis on increasing the number and diversity of expert-generated reasoning questions.
blocks.zh: 若干成果值得进一步讨论。 准确性不遵循价格:最精确的型号是双子座 3.8 Flash,在视频轨道上每题约花费了五分之一的GPT-5.6 Sol(图9). 虽然我们通过拖鞋抓住统计不确定性,但我们没有系统地调查反复运行的模型的迅速敏感性或可变性。 请注意,在这方面,在扩大的外科视频上评价长文本的VLM需要花费大量的货币和环境成本(见图9),这突出表明需要优先制定有效的评价协议。 最后,数据集来源于有限的节能程序,这些节能程序可能引入与外科手术风格、仪器、病人数量或记录条件有关的偏见。 因此,基准业绩不应被解释为跨程序、机构或临床环境安全通用的证据。 今后的工作应当扩大基准中体现的程序、机构和外科环境的多样性,同时特别强调增加专家提出的推理问题的数量和多样性。

blocks.en: In conclusion, through its clinically grounded design, capability-centric evaluation, and rigorous multi-stage annotation process, HeiCo-FOCUS establishes a fundamentally new testbed for assessing whether modern Vision-Language Models can move beyond short-term pattern recognition toward reliable long-horizon reasoning. By exposing failures in cumulative temporal consistency, it provides a foundation for developing and evaluating models that can operate reliably in complex, real-world settings.
blocks.zh: 最后,通过基于临床的设计、以能力为中心的评价以及严格的多阶段注释过程,HeiCo-FOCUS建立了一个全新的试验台,用于评估现代Vision-Language Models是否能够超越短期模式识别而转向可靠的长视野推理。 通过揭露累积时间一致性方面的失败,它为开发和评价能够在复杂而现实的环境中可靠运作的模型奠定了基础。

blocks.en: Appendix C Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 附录 C 分类学

blocks.en: Object recognition and identity matching : Recognition of object instances, their semantic type, attributes, spatial context, and identity consistency across time. Subcategories: • Object identification: semantic classification of visible object instances • Object instance identity matching: correspondence of object instances across time • Object attributes and state: recognition of observable object properties or handling states • Object spatial localization (camera): object localization relative to the image plane • Object spatial localization (situs): object localization relative to anatomical structures

blocks.en: E.2 Foreign Object Definitions
blocks.zh: E.2 外国物体定义

blocks.en: === FOREIGN OBJECT DEFINITION ===
blocks.zh: === 外国目标定义

blocks.en: A foreign object is any object fully introduced into the patient’s body cavity during surgery that must be retrieved or accounted for. Importantly, standard surgical instruments that remain connected to the external environment (e.g., graspers, scissors, trocars, staplers, cameras) are not considered foreign objects. Furthermore, we exclude detachable parts of surgical instruments, particularly anvil components of staplers.
blocks.zh: 异物是指在手术期间完全引入病人身体腔并必须取出或说明原因的任何物体。 重要的是,仍然与外部环境相通的标准外科仪器(如抓取器、剪刀、拖车、订书机、相机等)不被视为外国物品。 此外,我们排除了外科手术器械的可切除部分,特别是主食器的阴道部件。

blocks.en: === FOREIGN OBJECT CLASSES ===
blocks.zh: === 外国目标类

blocks.en: The following are the only classes to consider. Do not infer or name any class outside this list, such as staples.
blocks.zh: 以下为唯一需要考虑的班级. 不得推断或点出本列表以外的任何类,如主食.

blocks.en: • Sponge : A soft, absorbent material used to soak up fluids. They are typically white when fresh and can become reddish-brown when saturated with blood. • External drain : A clear or fluid-filled tube used to evacuate fluids from the surgical site to the outside of the body. Its tip may be temporarily visible within the surgical field during placement or adjustment. • Needle : A sharp, pointed metal instrument, straight or curved, used for placing sutures. A needle is considered visible only if the metallic needle itself is seen. The suture thread alone does not qualify as needle visibility. • Clip : A small metal or polymer device used to seal vessels or ducts. May potentially remain in the body. Clips only count as foreign objects once placed in the abdomen. They do not count as foreign objects while loaded within the clip applier instrument. • Specimen bag : A sterile pouch used to collect and retrieve resected tissue or organs from the body cavity. Only consider the pouch itself as a foreign object and ignore the string attached to it. • Silicone loop : A soft and flexible, typically white band used to encircle and control blood vessels or structures for isolation and traction. • Specimen : Excised biological tissue (e.g., appendix, resected bowel segment) that must be retrieved from the body cavity before completion of the procedure. Tissue is considered a foreign object once it is fully detached from surrounding anatomy. This excludes fat and blood. Specimens contained within a specimen bag are considered retrieved; specimen bags are annotated separately. • Absorbable hemostatic agent : A soft, absorbable material (for example oxidized cellulose or a gelatin sponge) applied to a bleeding surface to promote clotting. It may be intentionally left inside the body cavity.

blocks.en: === TEMPORAL AND VISIBILITY RULES ===
blocks.zh: === 临时规则和观察员规则

blocks.en: • A foreign object is considered inserted / introduced at the moment it first becomes partially visible inside the body cavity. In case of clips, it is also required to leave the clip applier. Class-specific visibility exceptions (e.g., needle string) take precedence. • A foreign object is considered present as long as it is inside the body cavity, even during periods of occlusion or when temporarily off-screen. • A foreign object is considered removed / retrieved at the moment it fully exits the body cavity or is fully inserted into a specimen bag. A specimen fully inside a specimen bag is considered retrieved; the specimen bag itself remains present until it exits the body cavity. • If the same physical object reappears after occlusion, it is the same instance — do not count it again. When multiple instances of the same class are present, reappearing objects should be attributed to already-known instances before assuming a new one. • All time references are given relative to the start of the intervention (00:00:00).

blocks.en: E.3 Format Instructions
blocks.zh: E.3 格式说明

blocks.en: The following output type-specific instructions are added to the prompt:
blocks.zh: 在提示中添加以下输出类型特定指令:

blocks.en: • Time point : Return the answer only in hh:mm:ss format without any additional text and with respect to the start of the procedure (not necessarily the start of the video clip). Example: 01:37:12 • Duration : Return the answer only in hh:mm:ss format without any additional text. Example: 00:02:13 • Foreign object class : Return only labels from the foreign objects list. Example: Sponge • Number : Return only a single integer value. Example: 3 • Percentage : Return only a single percentage value between 0 and 100 without the percent sign. Example: 75 • Binary : Return only yes or no. blocks.en: You are assisting in the analysis of laparoscopic videos from minimally invasive surgeries. Specifically, you see a video from a Sigmoid Resection from timepoint 00:14:40 to 00:19:21. The video is sampled at 1 fps. Analyze the footage and answer the question based on the visual evidence. Be precise and concise. === FOREIGN OBJECT DEFINITION === A foreign object is any object fully introduced into the patient’s body cavity during surgery that must be retrieved or accounted for. Importantly, standard surgical instruments that remain connected to the external environment (e.g., graspers, scissors, trocars, staplers, cameras) are not considered foreign objects. Furthermore, we exclude detachable parts of surgical instruments, particularly anvil components of staplers. === FOREIGN OBJECT CLASSES === The following are the only classes to consider. Do not infer or name any class outside this list, such as staples. Sponge: A soft, absorbent material used to soak up fluids. They are typically white when fresh and can become reddish-brown when saturated with blood. External drain: A clear or fluid-filled tube used to evacuate fluids from the surgical site to the outside of the body. Its tip may be temporarily visible within the surgical field during placement or adjustment. Needle: A sharp, pointed metal instrument, straight or curved, used for placing sutures. A needle is considered visible only if the metallic needle itself is seen. The suture thread alone does not qualify as needle visibility. Clip: A small metal or polymer device used to seal vessels or ducts. May potentially remain in the body. Clips only count as foreign objects once placed in the abdomen. They do not count as foreign objects while loaded within the clip applier instrument. Specimen bag: A sterile pouch used to collect and retrieve resected tissue or organs from the body cavity. Only consider the pouch itself as foreign object and ignore the string attached to it. Silicone loop: A soft and flexible, typically white band used to encircle and control blood vessels or structures for isolation and traction. Specimen: Excised biological tissue (e.g., appendix, resected bowel segment) that must be retrieved from the body cavity before completion of the procedure. Tissue is considered a foreign object once it is fully detached from surrounding anatomy. This excludes fat and blood. Specimens contained within a specimen bag are considered retrieved; specimen bags are annotated separately. Absorbable hemostatic agent: A soft, absorbable material (for example oxidized cellulose or a gelatin sponge) applied to a bleeding surface to promote clotting. It may be intentionally left inside the body cavity. === TEMPORAL AND VISIBILITY RULES === A foreign object is considered inserted / introduced at the moment it first becomes partially visible inside the body cavity. In case of clips, it is also required to leave the clip applier. Class-specific visibility exceptions (e.g., needle string) take precedence. A foreign object is considered present as long as it is inside the body cavity, even during periods of occlusion or when temporarily off-screen. A foreign object is considered removed / retrieved at the moment it fully exits the body cavity or is fully inserted into a specimen bag. A specimen fully inside a specimen bag is considered retrieved; the specimen bag itself remains present until it exits the body cavity. If the same physical object reappears after occlusion, it is the same instance -- do not count it again. When multiple instances of the same class are present, reappearing objects should be attributed to already-known instances before assuming a new one. All time references are given relative to the start of the intervention (00:00:00). After the Sponge was inserted in the abdomen, which different foreign object classes were inserted or created (in case of a specimen) afterwards, if any? Please provide the class name(s) or answer none. Return only labels from the foreign objects list above. Example: Sponge. Strictly adhere to these output format specifications. Do not add any extra text.
blocks.zh: 你们正在协助分析 最小入侵手术的脑膜影像 具体地说,你可以看到一段视频,从时间点00:14:40到00:19:21的Sigmoid Resection. 视频在 1 fps 采样. 根据视觉证据分析镜头并回答问题. 准确而简洁. === 外国目标定义 异物是指在手术期间完全引入病人身体腔并必须取出或说明原因的任何物体。 重要的是,仍然与外部环境相通的标准外科仪器(如抓取器、剪刀、拖车、订书机、相机等)不被视为外国物品。 此外,我们排除了外科手术器械的可切除部分,特别是主食器的阴道部件。 === 外国目标类 以下为唯一需要考虑的班级. 不得推断或点出本列表以外的任何类,如主食. 海绵:一种软而能吸收的材料,用来浸出流体. 它们通常在新鲜时为白色,在饱和后会变成红褐色。 外部排出量: 用于将外科手术现场的出液物分出至外出体外的清晰或充满流体的管. 在放置或调整期间,其尖口可在外科手术场内暂时可见. 针: 直立或弯曲的尖尖金属仪器,用于接缝. 只有看到金属针本身,才认为是可见的. 单是缝线不能作为针能见度. 剪辑 : 用于密封容器或管道的小型金属或聚合器. 可能留在体内。 剪接只算作放置于腹部的外物体. 它们在装入插件应用仪器时不计为外国物体。 样本袋:用于从身体腔取出并取回被重新分解的组织或器官的无菌邮袋. 只将邮袋本身视为外物而忽略了所附带的字符串. 硅酮环: 软而灵活的,一般是白色的带子,用来包围和控制血管或结构来进行隔离和牵引. 标本:在程序完成前必须从体内腔取出的货物化生物组织(如:附录,被重新剖开的肠道段). 组织一旦完全脱离周边解剖学,就被认为是外天体. 这不包括脂肪和血液。 标本袋中所含的样本视为取回;标本袋另作说明. 活性肝脏活性剂:一种软而可吸收的材料(例如氧化纤维素或胶原海绵)被应用到出血的表面来促进血块分解. 它可能被故意留在身体腔内. === 临时规则和观察员规则 外来物体在首次在体腔内部分可见时即视为被插入/引入. 对于剪辑,还需要留下剪辑的应用. 阶级特有能见度例外(如针弦)优先. 外国物体只要在身体腔内,即使在被隔离期间或暂时被屏蔽时,就被视为存在. 异物在完全出体腔时即被视为被取出/取出,或被完全插入标本袋. 完全在标本袋内的标本被视为取回;标本袋本身一直存在到出出体腔. 如果同一物理物体在被隔离后再次出现,就是同一实例 -- -- 不要再计算。 当同一类的多个实例存在时,重现对象在假设新的实例之前,应归结为已经知道的实例. 所有时间参考都与发言开始时间(00:00)相对. 在海绵被插入后,如果有的话,腹部会插入或创建哪些不同的外星物体类别(如果是标本的话)? 请提供类名或回答无。 只从上面的外天体列表返回标签 。 例子:海绵. 严格遵守这些出品格式规范. 不添加任何额外的文本。

blocks.zh: 附录F 大语文模型法官的审定

blocks.en: Open-ended, multiple-choice, and matching answers are graded by gpt-oss-120b. To test the judge against human grading, we drew 164 open-ended answers (76 FRAME, 76 SEGMENT, and 12 PROCEDURE), stratified by track and by the verdict of a judge model (Llama 4 Maverick), with equal numbers of accepted and rejected answers. Two raters, a surgical resident and a surgical data science researcher, graded each answer independently. Like the judge, they did not see the judge’s verdict. Weighted to the population the answers were drawn from, gpt-oss-120b agrees with the resident on 90.7% of answers ( κ = 0.74 \kappa=0.74 ) and with the second rater on 92.7% ( κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 ), while the two raters agree with each other on 91.8% ( κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 ). The judge is the stricter grader in 13 of its 15 disagreements with the resident and in 7 of 13 with the second rater, so grading by the raters would, if anything, raise the reported accuracies.
blocks.zh: 开放式多选择,并配对的答案被gpt-oss-120b分级. 为了检验法官的等级,我们提出了164个没有限制的答案(76个FRAME、76个Semment和12个程序),按轨道和法官模型(Llama 4 Maverick)的判决进行分级,接受和拒绝的答复数量相等。 两名评分员,一名外科住院医生和一名外科数据科学研究员,分别独立分出每个答题. 同法官一样,他们没有看到法官的判决。 对居民来说,答案是从gpt-oss-120b中得出的,与居民就90.7%的答案(of = 0.74\kappa= 0.74)和92.7%的第二个答案(of = 0.78\kappa= 0.78)达成一致,而两个评估者就91.8%(of = 0.78\kappa= 0.78)达成一致。 法官在与居民的15起分歧中,有13起是更严格的分级者,在13起中,有7起是二级分级者,因此,如果按分级者进行分级,就会增加所报告的分级。
